column1: # Probe: does walking in swamp poison the party, and after how many steps?
# requires-seed: the party on grass at (64,14), south of the swamp at (64,12)
# Encounter traffic: a wandering-creature spawn can land on either side
# during the walk (`encounters.md`; `prng.md` Section 3 seeds the generator
# from the host clock, so the two sides never share the roll). Rare: the
# stock side met none in the 21 runs from 2026-09-07 to the rc4 sweep
# stood beside the party at step 9 and `Attacked!` / `*** CONFLICT ***`
# followed at step 10, while the engine walked on exactly as rc4 did and
# its beats 1-9 still agreed. A run like that measures the spawn roll, not
# the engine; `paired_suite.py` retries this scenario once on a difference
